item.title: MARVIN COMPPER AND HIS 83 MINUTES OF FAME
item.description: MARVIN COMPPER is in Celtic’s history books as one of the club’s most baffling transfers. Brendan Rodgers sanctioned a £1.2million move for the RB Leipzig central defender in January 2018. Compper played his first – and last – game against Morton in a Scottish Cup-tie at Parkhead on March 3 – exactly eight years ago [...]
